verdict.rationale: Rootly's docs say you can declare, run, and resolve incidents from Slack, Google Chat, and Microsoft Teams (rootly-docs-1). Workflows create incident channels in Slack or Teams and keep stakeholders updated (rootly-docs-45, rootly-docs-34), and in-channel commands and @Rootly prompts can change severity, page teams, and post summaries (rootly-docs-86, rootly-docs-87, rootly-docs-30). Community comments describing Rootly as Slack-centric independently confirm that the chat-driven flow is the core design (rootly-comm-5, rootly-comm-4). missing for 10: explicit documentation of incident role assignment from chat, depth of Teams-side incident-running parity versus Slack, hands-on corroboration of auto-created updates.
